objective: Determine what a small, explicitly conjectural astronomical crib set constrains under a fixed finite word-equation family, preserving every attested local transcription variant recovered before evaluation.
prior_exposure: All five proposed readings, paper Figure1, relevant ZL/IT lines and historical interlinears have been consulted. Original Yale crops inspected by the same operator, who knows the proposed readings. The repeated-o contradiction in doaro/TOARE was noticed before freeze. This is a confirmatory formal audit of an exposed hypothesis, not blind historical validation.
anchors: ANCHORS.json. Figure1 A=POLAR, B=EXPE, C=TOARE, D=O'CETE, E=O'COR. Lowercase and remove apostrophes only. No expansion to named celestial objects. B is the word beyond the star on a radial line, not a standalone @Ls record.
variants: All8 Cartesian combinations of A cholar/chodar, B ypchy/yypchy and C doaro/doary; D otydy and E otor fixed. Preserve sources of each form. Delete interlinear ! padding and surrounding structural markers only, explicitly documented; no change within the normalized alphabetic word.
family: Reuse unmodified phase30 equations.py and common.py. Plaintext-letter codes have1..3 EVA characters, are injective and prefix-free. Direction+1/-1. Optional common silent suffix length0..2 in the oriented cipher. No omitted plaintext letters, per-word edits, anagrams, language model or dictionary. Unused letters remain undetermined.
solver: Maximum2000000 search nodes per call. Stop on second distinct model. Ambiguous means at least2 witnesses, not a complete enumeration. Resource limit must never be treated as inconsistency or uniqueness.
fit: For each variant, solve the five published pairs. Also solve each distinct single pair as a diagnostic. Full fit does not validate semantics.
rivals: For each variant enumerate all120 permutations of the five proposed strings over the same five loci. Include the published assignment. Report consistency and uniqueness counts, not p-values: the proposed strings were chosen using these glyphs and lengths.
leave_one_out: For all8 variants and5 loci fit the other4 pairs. Decode the omitted cipher only with a unique fitted model; report missing plaintext letters and unknown cipher codes. Never complete a missing value by looking at the omitted answer. These are dependence diagnostics among published seeds, not independent held-out discoveries.
projection: Only if a published five-pair fit is unique, apply its partial code literally to every @Ls locus in f68r1/f68r2/f68r3 in both original ZL and IT. No variant overlay in this projection. Accept lowercase alphabetic tokens separated by certain full stops; retain all other loci with explicit unsupported-markup status. Preserve unknown-code errors. Mark training loci separately. Report all complete strings, not only lexical-looking examples. No dictionary, star catalogue, language score or French translation.
mechanical_checks: Synthetic exact equations with known forward/reversed codes and common suffix, injectivity/prefix violations, ambiguity, resource exhaustion and unsupported-code checks. These verify the software family and do not establish historical decipherment capability.
outcomes: Full fit,960 permuted assignments,40 leave-one-out cases, and complete literal projection table where possible. Semantic validation remains false without an independent historical witness and predictive continuous readings. No transcription is selected because it fits the proposed words.
limits: EVA can collapse graphical distinctions. The authors' full table permits overlapping ligatures and polyphony beyond this family. Source transcripts concern the same manuscript and are not independent semantic witnesses. The8 local combinations may mix different transcribers. The candidate plaintexts are abbreviated conjectures. Images are inspected by a non-independent AI operator, not adjudicated by a palaeographer.
verification: After scoring, independently enumerate finite length-compositions of the word equations, check model witnesses and every projection, then rerun frozen study code in a fresh temporary directory and compare outputs byte-for-byte. Same operator, no external replication claim.
delivery: Local reproducible dossier and durable archive; no external publication, push or message. The decipherment goal stays open unless the manuscript is actually decoded and independently validated.
